tasks.description: Stop three recurring manual fixes on the Build line: (1) Modify build-spec.js's Risk Router (HIGH_REF regex) to exclude 'author'/'authored'/'authority' while keeping auth/authn/authz/authentication/authenticate(d)/authorization(s) terms flagged; (2) Add changeScopedCriteria pure function to build-implement.js's fix-loop decisions block that identifies criteria whose THEN asserts something is unchanged/identical/not added-removed relative to base, and integrate it into the Test Author prompt to tell the agent not to write tests for such criteria; (3) Add testFileBasename pure normalizer to fix-loop decisions that strips trailing parentheticals and directories from test file paths, and update unaccountedTestFiles and unlandedRepairs to use it so lander reporting 'x.js (already exists)' no longer produces false unaccounted-file findings.
